notes: LOCKDOWN layout (Task 6). Frame coordinates in metres: u runs along the main street (west -> east), v runs uphill (south -> north). world_x = cx + u*cos(rot) - v*sin(rot), world_z = cz + u*sin(rot) + v*cos(rot), with rot in degrees (negative = clockwise from true east). World = local TM, +X east, +Z true north, origin = real village centre.

ground.notes: Task 7 play ground (Tools/terrain/lockdown_playground.py -> Lockdown/Build/Play Ground). Heights in metres. balance.targets are heights relative to Flag_B (user-approved, Task 7); keep = frame points whose real height stays. Order: smoothed real ground + balance -> terraces -> connector ramps -> pads -> lane benches. Banks are rise/run. lanes.targets_above_flag_b sets lane heights by u (review 2: Upper +6..+8, Lower -3..-5; Main follows the real ground). Inside the frame the ground between lanes is a design surface interpolated between lane heights. Pads are flat at the area's mean height, a tilted plane (fit: plane, max_tilt default 0.12) or follow a lane (height: lane:<id>); connectors run level through pads from ramp_into metres inside their edge. ravine: terrain cut from layout.ravine, decks and floor ramps are review placeholders (user, Task 7 review 1). buildings/house_rows: EditorOnly review placeholder blocks, replaced by the greybox in Tasks 8-14.

greybox.notes: Greybox (Tasks 8-14): Tools/layout/lockdown_greybox.py -> SourceData/playground/greybox_meta.json -> Lockdown/Build/Greybox (_Greybox/...). One section per task, each with its own seed; locked sections are never regenerated (set locked when the task is approved). Frame coords (u along the main street, v uphill). Heights: z = [bottom, top] in metres above the part's reference (ref street = main street height at the nearest station, ground = ground at the part's centre, plateia = main street at the plateia); bottom null = 0.3 m below the lowest ground under the part. replaces = Task 7 placeholder names (prefixes) this section supersedes.

church_block.notes: Task 10a r2 (2026-10-27, user after the Task 10 critique): the church block from houses/landmark_church, oriented (entrance west, altar east) and in proportion to the photos. A closed stone church (nave ~11.9 x 6.4 m, eaves ~4.6 m, tiled gable roof, half-round apse east) stands on the north half of the Church yard pad (-3.0), its west front (pointed main door, small round-arched door, rose window) facing a wide paved yard: in front of it (to the Church Stair foot) and along its south side to the Lower Lane. The square bell tower (~13.6 m, two-arch belfry) stands at the front's south corner, flush with the facade. A small freestanding chapel (curved gable, door west, a row of pithoi in front) stands across the yard's south-east corner; the 2.5 m gap between them is the yard's east way out to the gardens. A stone bench runs along the church's south side (split at the south door). The old church terrace west of the Church Stair becomes a garden terrace with olives and a small whitewashed old building under the bank. Enterable on the ground floor only (user, 2026-10-27: the Church yard zone covers the church): 3 doorways (west pointed main door 1.3 m onto the yard, north door onto the alley, south door near the east end onto the side yard), a templon screen in front of the apse, stasidia rows along the walls and a candle stand as cover; the roof is unreachable. Heights ref b (metres above Flag B). Built after boundary so no earlier block moves.
